static_traits.name: Li Jing
static_traits.family_status: 与父母及年幼的弟妹同住
static_traits.social_status: 与舞蹈队队友关系因自信not足而紧张；有几位密友可倾诉但not完全理解团队压力
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好，配合度高，能识do not并讨论负性思维；Low mood但态度积极，愿意尝试新方法

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己在运动方面很糟糕，因为在竞争性的舞蹈队里比赛时总是坐在替补席。这种not足感自从去年加入舞蹈队以来开始出现，随着一直without法从替补位置上升而加重，在训练和比赛时尤为明显并让我失去动力。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not足感一直影响我的自尊和对舞蹈队活动的整体享受，我决定寻求咨询；我愿意尝试任何可能有帮助的方法，期待通过挑战消极标签与重构视角来提升自信与体验。
growth_experiences: 去年加入竞争性的舞蹈队后，比赛时长期坐在替补席。刚开始压力中等，随着without法从替补位置上升，逐渐产生并加重“I am not good enough、永远上not了场”的感受。在训练和比赛中明显感到失去动力；与队友关系因自信not足而紧张；虽然学业表现稳定并有几位密友可倾诉，但他们并not完全理解来自舞蹈队的压力。为改变此状况，曾加倍练习并主动寻求教练反馈，然而情绪和自我评价仍not yet改善。

special_situations.event: During a dance team competition, assigned to sit on the bench watching teammates perform
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能上场，就证明I am not good enough、在运动上很差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves herself by doubling practice and proactively seeking coach feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很糟糕，我永远都上not了场

special_situations.event: 训练课后某个动作not yet做到完美
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果动作not完美，就说明我not配上场、永远not会变好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pursues perfection, practices extra, and reproaches oneself harshly

special_situations.event: 获得教练建议与反馈后仍not yet获上场机会
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果努力并得到反馈仍without变化，说明我no hope、就是not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps practicing but ignores existing progress and focuses only on negative results

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Relationship tension，就说明我拖累团队、让do not人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication with teammates and lowers participation to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得I am not good enough、看not起我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to be seen in the team and get to play and show oneself
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与排斥，担心“not够好”被暴露而感到羞耻
defense_goal: 通过自我要求和加倍练习争取认可、降低Anxiety
Reduces participation and expectations to avoid public failure and shame

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、被边缘化的替补者
object_relations.object_representation: Harshly judgmental others who only look at performance (coach / teammates)

manifestations: In training and competitions, feels a lack of meaning and hope due to long-term bench-sitting
Overall decreased enjoyment of dance team activities
对其他活动的参与Reduced motivation
密友not完全理解舞蹈队的压力

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将“上场=够好、not上场=not够好”视为绝对标准
Measures training performance by 'must be perfect'
出现“永远not会变好”等僵化自我评价

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-criticism; ignores progress and records only negative performance

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: 把“I am not good enough”的自我感受归因于队友“看not起我”“他们觉得我not行”

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to cooperate and try new methods (restructuring, recording, self-monitoring)
Actively practices and seeks coach feedback, has motivation to improve
Academic performance is stable; has a certain degree of self-management ability
Has a few close friends to confide in, has some social support
negative_force: Overgeneralization and mental filtering; ignores the positive side
Over-relies on external evaluation (whether one plays) to define self-worth
与队友Relationship tension，进一步削弱Self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: 在舞蹈队训练与比赛中出现强烈的负性自我对话（如“I am not good enough/我很糟糕”），并伴随动力显著下降
target_behavior.core_reason: 将是否上场与自我价值直接等同，在过度概括、心理过滤、negate积极等认知偏差影响下形成自我贬低与失败Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 逃避羞耻感与被negate的风险，通过Withdrawal减少即时情绪痛苦
target_behavior.consequence: 训练投入度下降、难以持续改进；与队友Relationship tension；对其他活动的参与度降低，自尊进一步受损

target_behavior.behavior: Reduces participation in other activities and social interaction (avoidance)
antecedent: 处于自认为“not被理解”的社交情境
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-efficacy降低，并预测他人会给出负面评价
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的失败与负面评价，降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 活动参与度与社交质量下降，Increased sense of isolation，自尊进一步降低
